purpose: Teach: 風速/乗船/高熱/鼓動/洗顔/授乳/浄水/脊髄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、屋外イベントは風速予報で判断しろ
lines.en: Outdoor events are to be judged by wind-speed forecasts.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Commands land like directives — no softening. Measured pace, each word weighted. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員旅行の乗船管理を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll establish strict protocols for managing boarding procedures on the company trip.
lines.style: Attentive, formal acknowledgement. Slightly faster tempo — eager to demonstrate competence. Clipped articulation. No inflection that might question the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の高熱発症時の対応マニュアルを整えろ
lines.en: Develop a manual for handling cases of high fever among staff.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Commands are delivered as necessities, not preferences. Slight pause before the key term. Composed, leaving no room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の鼓動、つまり成長の脈拍を測ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll measure the company's vital signs — the pulse of our growth — with precision.
lines.style: Respectful but engaged. Slight lift on the metaphor — showing he understands the strategic weight. Careful pacing. A touch more personal investment than mere compliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の洗顔習慣も衛生研修に含めろ
lines.en: Include staff hygiene practices—face washing habits—in the safety training.
lines.style: Direct, almost matter-of-fact in its simplicity. Slight emphasis on the parenthetical clarification. The tone of someone used to spelling out what should be obvious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の授乳室を社内に設置します
lines.en: Yes. We'll install nursing rooms for staff within the workplace.
lines.style: Affirming and forward-moving. Brisk pace that shows momentum. Each commitment lands solidly. Professional warmth beneath the formality — taking care of people.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、防災用浄水器を備蓄しろ
lines.style: Economical with words. Each term precise and functional. Cool, measured delivery. The confidence of someone who has seen what happens when you prepare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の脊髄健康のため姿勢改善研修を実施します
lines.en: Yes. We'll implement posture-correction training to ensure spinal health for our staff.
lines.style: Steady close. Slight elongation on the final phrase — the note of care. Confident but not rushed. The sense of a man who has absorbed his manager's expectations and is delivering them with measured competence.
